summary: Indian markets enter October after a volatile September marked by significant FII outflows and fluctuating oil prices. While the government's cut in windfall taxes provides relief to energy exporters, hospital stocks face pressure from regulatory scrutiny. Investors remain cautious as global cues and bond yields influence pre-market sentiment.
